“Thank you for an amazing time to celebrate my son’s 18th Birthday ! There were 6 of us in the group. The instructors were great, it was a perfect day to jump out of the plane and the view was breathtaking. Our group had a ton of fun and are still talking about it a month later. Hope to do it again!”

– Tiffany E.

“EXCELLENT! very professional! Glad i brought my son on his first jump there!”

– Beth O.

“On October 24, 2020, I had the greatest experience ever 13,500 feet up with the “gorgeous, blue eyed Taylor” who made sure I felt safe and had fun every skydiving moment. I would 100% do it all over again. Thank you for the memory and cheers to you Tim McGraw!”

– Priscilla B. [...] Book Online

## Why Choose Skydive Suffolk?

Choosing where to make your first skydive (or your 100th jump) is an important decision. At Skydive Suffolk, we’re committed to providing an exciting and memorable experience from the moment you arrive until you touch back down. Whether you’re crossing an item off your bucket list, celebrating a special occasion, or simply looking for an unforgettable adventure, our experienced team is here to make your jump one you’ll never forget. It gives you a new perspective on life, making you stronger, braver and more present in the moment, as you embrace this amazing experience.

## Reviews [...] – Kathleen C.

“Professional organization. Very organized. Large enough to handle big groups in an orderly and timely fashion. Expert instructors. Friendly staff. Aaron R, a 25 year army airborne vet was my instructor. What a pro and a fun person. Had a blast! Several aircraft in their inventory. If you want a superior skydiving experience and instruction, this is the place.”

– Clint F.
